title: Hotel Room Key App
scenario: A text says mobile key setup requires your hotel login through a shortened link.

answers.A: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.B: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.C: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.
answers.D: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.

explanation: Hotel Room Key App: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: Set up mobile keys inside the hotel app.
